Lemma
[The model polar volume]

↗ def:sinh-comparison-function ↗ lem:polar-coordinates

Write $\rho _k(v)=\bigl(\sn _k(|v|)/|v|\bigr)^{n-1}$ for the volume density of the exponential map of the model space $H^n_k$ (Lemma lem:constant-curvature-jacobi), and $\Vol B_{H^n_k}(q_k,r)=\int _{B(0,r)}\rho _k\, d\mu $. Then \[ \Vol B_{H^n_k}(q_k,r)=\omega _{n-1}\int _0^r\sn _k^{n-1}(t)\, dt, \qquad \omega _{n-1}:=\mu _S(S). \]

Proof

\sketch ↗ lem:polar-coordinates Apply Lemma lem:polar-coordinates to $f=\rho _k$. Since $\rho _k$ depends only on $|v|$, the inner integrand is $t^{n-1}\rho _k(t\omega )=t^{n-1}(\sn _k(t)/t)^{n-1} =\sn _k^{n-1}(t)$, independent of $\omega $: the radial weight $t^{n-1}$ of polar coordinates cancels the $|v|^{-(n-1)}$ in the density. The angular integral is then the constant $\mu _S(S)=\omega _{n-1}$.

□
